name: Vivid+Co
mood: Cinematic dark agency system with obsidian canvas, near-white typography, huge weight-400 Neue Montreal display type, sparse UI chrome, and a single RGB prism artifact as the only chromatic voice.

boneWhite.role: Primary text, nav labels, link color, heading fill, and almost every interactive element.

obsidian.role: Page canvas, hero void, and full-bleed dark sections.

graphiteVeil.role: Cool dark slate surface behind headings and content blocks.

ashBorder.role: Hairline divider and rare card outline.

fogBlue.role: Muted secondary text, ghost labels, and de-emphasized metadata.

pureBlack.role: Decorative SVG icon and illustration fill; not a page background.

prismRed.role: RGB prism artifact channel only; not a UI token.

prismCyan.role: RGB prism artifact channel only; not a UI token.

prismLime.role: RGB prism artifact channel only; not a UI token.

fallbacks.primary: Sohne, Inter, General Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

rules: Use Neue Montreal-style type across the entire interface.
Keep weight 400 as the default for headings, body, nav, buttons, links, and footer.
Reserve weight 700 for rare 36px subheadings only.
Set display headings at 105px to 136px with line-height near 1.00.
Do not use 600 to 800 weights for display headings.

shadows.none: Depth comes from dark surface contrast and the prism artifact, not shadows.

components.name: Ghost Nav Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Bone White uppercase Neue Montreal 14px to 15px, 0px radius, no padding, no underline, no border.

components.name: Outlined Contact Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Bone White border, 5px radius, 9px by 15px padding, uppercase 14px Bone White text.

components.name: Ghost Service Label
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Fog Blue text, 0px radius, 20px top padding, 30px bottom padding, Neue Montreal 20px.

components.name: Display Headline Block
components.recipe: Neue Montreal 400 at 105px to 136px, line-height 1.00 to 1.01, -0.02em tracking, Bone White.

components.name: Hero Lead Paragraph
components.recipe: Neue Montreal 400 at 18px to 22px, line-height 1.5, Bone White, max-width around 440px.

components.name: Prism Artifact
components.recipe: Glass-cube cluster with Pure Black cores, Bone White highlights, and RGB channel-offset red/cyan/lime edges.

components.name: Section Heading
components.recipe: Small 18px to 22px Bone White statement above a larger display headline, max-width around 440px.

components.name: Footer Hairline Divider
components.recipe: 1px Ash Border rule, full width, used as the primary footer separator.

components.name: Case Study Title Link
components.recipe: Neue Montreal 400 at 33px, Bone White, line-height 1.2, -0.01em tracking, no underline.

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.recipe: Uppercase Neue Montreal 17px or 32px, weight 400, with slight positive tracking at small sizes.

components.name: Rounded Pill Tag
components.recipe: 9999px radius metadata chip used rarely; most UI stays square-edged.

do: Use Bone White for nearly all text and interactive elements.
Use Fog Blue only for de-emphasized metadata.
Let scale create hierarchy instead of heavier weights.
Keep Neue Montreal weight 400 as the default.
Set display type at 105px to 136px with line-height near 1.00.
Use 0px radius for buttons and most UI.
Make the prism artifact the only chromatic element.
dont: Do not introduce filled buttons, CTA colors, badges, or broad gradients.
Do not use Prism Red, Cyan, or Lime anywhere outside the prism artwork.
Do not use weight 600 to 800 for display headings.
Do not add box shadows to cards, nav, or artwork.
Do not lighten the canvas beyond Graphite Veil.
Do not build multi-column SaaS grids or pricing-card layouts.
